summary.tldr: Requires courts to treat assaults on health care workers as an aggravating factor when sentencing certain Criminal Code offences.
what_it_does: Requires courts to consider it an aggravating circumstance when the victim of certain assault offences was a health care worker doing their job.
Defines health care worker to include people working in hospitals, residential facilities, treatment clinics, pharmacies, and homes where someone receives home care.
Applies to sentencing for offences under paragraph 264.1(1)(a) and sections 266 to 269 of the Criminal Code.
summary.background: The bill adds a new section to the Criminal Code on sentencing for assaults against health care workers.
